PresetGuardrails.title: PresetGuardrails
PresetGuardrails.description:
What the owner wants held in a preset besides the models: each key is left alone, set, or removed.

A key that is ``None`` and not in ``clear`` is not managed: whatever is on the preset at OpenRouter stays, and is
sent back with every write. A value is managed: it is written. A key named in ``clear`` is managed too, and is
taken off the preset. One key cannot be both.

set.title: Set
set.description: The guardrails this plan writes, by key, with their values: `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `repetition_penalty`, `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, `top_p`, `quantizations`, `ignore`, `require_parameters` and `system_prompt`. A key that is not here is not managed, and the live value stays.

PresetSettings.title: PresetSettings
PresetSettings.description:
One OpenRouter preset Vibonomics keeps pointed at the best-value models, and how it picks them.

Off by default: nothing is written to the OpenRouter account until ``enabled`` is set. The slug always starts
with ``vibonomics-`` (it is added to whatever name is typed), so a preset the operator made by hand can never be
the one that is rewritten, unless the operator adopted it: ``adopted`` keeps the slug as typed, and grants
nothing by itself, because the engine also wants the adoption to be on record.
